[d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1] decision (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Gate `report_against` and its tests on `gemini` or `anthropic` features
  The function is only reached from the feature-gated `gemini` and `anthropic` mappers, so builds without those features had an unused function and CI's `-D warnings` failed.
  -> causes q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1
  -> causes q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-3
  -> causes q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-2

[d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2] decision (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Leave the `jitter` unused failure in `--no-default-features` unrepaired
  It is pre-existing, fails the same way on the previous commit, is outside CI's matrix, and should not be folded into this repair.
  -> causes q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-1] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Remove the local-improvement pass (§18.3 step 3).
  It was making packs worse; across 28,000 generated packs it changed 26 and 22 were worse by the value function it exists to maximise.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-1-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-2] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Remove `IMPROVEMENT_PASSES` constant and `PackRequest::improvement_passes` field.
  A knob for a pass that no longer exists is worse than no knob.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-2-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-3] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Decline to keep the search that measured the pass.
  With the pass gone it would compare two identical configurations, and a test that cannot fail is the shape this project keeps deleting.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-3-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-4] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Decline to update the golden file.
  The golden file is byte-identical after the removal; no selections moved, so there is nothing to record.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-4-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-5] decision (cited, source crates/smysl-pack/src/solve.rs@a18e230ae345)
  Add a comment explaining the removal in place of the loop.
  To document why the pass was removed, including the measurements that justified it.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-5-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-6] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@a18e230ae345)
  Document the removal in the changelog.
  To record the removal and its justification for the 0.8.0 release notes.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-6-1

[e/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1] evidence (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Check: Verified against both failing CI commands and each provider feature on its own.
  -> backs q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1

[e/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2-1] evidence (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Check: fails the same way on the previous commit
  -> backs q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2-1

[e/ga18e230ae345-1-1] evidence (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Check: Across 28 000 generated packs it changed 26, and 22 of those 26 were *worse* by the value function …
  Check: Across 28 000 generated packs it changed 26, and 22 of those 26 were *worse* by the value function it exists to maximise.
  -> backs q/ga18e230ae345-1-1

[e/ga18e230ae345-4-1] evidence (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Check: The golden file is byte-identical after the removal: nine fixtures at six budgets, not one selection …
  Check: The golden file is byte-identical after the removal: nine fixtures at six budgets, not one selection moved.
  -> backs q/ga18e230ae345-4-1

[p/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1] constraint (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  `report_against` is only reached from the `gemini` and `anthropic` mappers, both feature-gated
  -> conditions d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1

[p/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-2] constraint (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  CI sets `-D warnings`, which refuses an unused function
  -> conditions d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1

[p/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2-1] constraint (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  `cargo check -p smysl-provider --no-default-features` fails on `jitter` being unused the same way on the …
  `cargo check -p smysl-provider --no-default-features` fails on `jitter` being unused the same way on the previous commit
  -> conditions d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2

[p/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2-2] constraint (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  The `jitter` unused failure is outside CI's matrix
  -> conditions d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2

[p/ga18e230ae345-1-1] constraint (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  The existing corpus never triggers the local-improvement pass, so removal does not change recorded selections.
  -> conditions d/ga18e230ae345-1

[p/ga18e230ae345-2-1] constraint (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  The local-improvement pass no longer exists after removal, leaving the constant and field unused.
  -> conditions d/ga18e230ae345-2

[p/ga18e230ae345-3-1] constraint (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  The local-improvement pass has been removed, so the search would compare identical configurations.
  -> conditions d/ga18e230ae345-3

[p/ga18e230ae345-4-1] constraint (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  The golden file content is unchanged after the removal, so there is nothing to record.
  -> conditions d/ga18e230ae345-4

[p/ga18e230ae345-5-1] constraint (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  The measurements showing the pass was harmful are accurate, as documented in the changelog.
  -> conditions d/ga18e230ae345-5

[p/ga18e230ae345-6-1] constraint (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@a18e230ae345)
  The changelog has an Unreleased — 0.8.0 section where the removal can be recorded.
  -> conditions d/ga18e230ae345-6

[q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1] finding (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Builds without those features no longer fail on unused function under `-D warnings`.

[q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-2] claim (inferred)
  `report_against` compiles only when `gemini` or `anthropic` feature is enabled.

[q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-3] claim (inferred)
  The `cap_tests` module compiles only when tests and relevant features are enabled.

[q/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2-1] finding (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  The no-default-features `jitter` unused failure remains unfixed and pre-existing.

[q/ga18e230ae345-1-1] finding (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  The local-improvement pass is removed because it made packs worse.

[q/ga18e230ae345-2-1] claim (inferred)
  IMPROVEMENT_PASSES constant and PackRequest::improvement_passes field removed from the public API.

[q/ga18e230ae345-3-1] claim (inferred)
  The search test is removed; keeping it would compare two identical configurations.

[q/ga18e230ae345-4-1] finding (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Golden file remains unchanged because no recorded selection moved.

[q/ga18e230ae345-5-1] claim (inferred)
  A comment in solve.rs documents the removal rationale and measurements.

[q/ga18e230ae345-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Changelog records the removal under Unreleased 0.8.0.

[r/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1] claim (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Rejected: Leave `report_against` ungated for builds without `gemini` or `anthropic`.
  Any build without them had an unused function and CI sets -D warnings.
  -> contrasts d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1

  Rejected: Fix the `jitter` unused warning in `--no-default-features` as part of this commit.
  It fails the same way on the previous commit, is pre-existing, outside CI's matrix, and not something to fold into a repair.
  -> contrasts d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-2

  -> contrasts d/ga18e230ae345-1

  A knob for a pass that no longer exists is worse than no knob.
  -> contrasts d/ga18e230ae345-2

  With the pass gone it would compare two identical configurations, and a test that cannot fail is the shape this project keeps deleting.
  -> contrasts d/ga18e230ae345-3

  The golden file is byte-identical after the removal; no selections moved, so there is nothing to record.
  -> contrasts d/ga18e230ae345-4

  Rejected: Remove the loop without adding an explanatory comment

  -> contrasts d/ga18e230ae345-5
